chain_results.question_answered: Is AI capex a real demand pool and what can it prove?
chain_results.minimum_quality_bar: Capex must be treated as demand-pool evidence, not as supplier allocation.
chain_results.writer_must_say: AI capex supports the existence of demand, but supplier capture needs product/deployment/supply-chain/financial bridge evidence.

chain_results.question_answered: How do NVIDIA, AMD and Google TPU differ in product capability and substitution risk?
chain_results.minimum_quality_bar: Product layer can be judged without SKU revenue, but cannot infer revenue, ASP, shipment or share.
chain_results.writer_must_say: Use product/spec/deployment evidence to judge product capability and substitution, while keeping revenue/share inference out of scope.

chain_results.question_answered: Who is deploying, configuring or adopting AI infrastructure products?
chain_results.minimum_quality_bar: Distinguish official deployment/configuration from demand proxy and relationship graph scope.
chain_results.writer_must_say: Deployment and OEM configuration support adoption direction, not total sales or margin unless order/backlog/financial rows exist.

chain_results.question_answered: Is Dell AI server growth high-quality profit or low-margin revenue pass-through?
chain_results.minimum_quality_bar: Revenue visibility and margin quality must be separated.
chain_results.writer_must_say: Dell has supported AI server revenue visibility if order/backlog rows exist, but margin-quality proof requires ISG margin and AI server mix/pass-through bridge.
chain_results.blocking_reason: Dell orders/backlog and ISG baseline exist as fixture rows, but AI server mix, GPU pass-through and margin bridge remain unresolved.

chain_results.question_answered: How does AI demand read through to foundry, packaging, HBM and semicap equipment?
chain_results.minimum_quality_bar: Separate TSMC, ASML, AMAT, LRCX and KLAC mechanisms; peer group scope is not evidence.
chain_results.writer_must_say: AI supports semicap read-through only through vendor-specific WFE, EUV/DUV, deposition/etch, process-control, advanced packaging or services evidence.

chain_results.question_answered: Is the AI infrastructure thesis already priced in?
chain_results.minimum_quality_bar: Do not make price-in claims without capital-feedback evidence.
chain_results.writer_must_say: Business evidence can be positive while market price-in remains unresolved until capital-feedback pack is available.
chain_results.blocking_reason: Public market context is live, but exact crowding, options positioning, borrow cost and institutional flow remain commercial/deeper-adapter boundaries.

chain_results.question_answered: What would weaken or change the AI/Semis thesis?
chain_results.minimum_quality_bar: Every positive thesis must carry counter-thesis and what-would-change conditions.
chain_results.writer_must_say: A credible workpaper states both the current bounded view and the evidence that would change it.
